Audience display

Use an extended desktop. The audience window shows slides only; your notes remain here.

Chrome and Edge can place the window on a selected display. Other browsers support moving the window by hand. Fullscreen may need one click in the audience window.

Reading and timing

The presentation requests screen-awake support where your browser allows it.
